messages:
incident-bot: :warning: Automated alert: sharp spike in 502/504 responses observed at api-gateway (edge-eu-west). 5m error rate ~30%, rollout region: EU-WEST. Dash: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/edge/errors-eu
Tara (SRE): Paging oncall. I'm taking this. First step: is this single host or multiple? Any recent infra/API changes?
Omar (Edge): No gateway code deploys in last 6h. I'm seeing a steep jump from edge-eu-07 and edge-eu-09. Kernel logs on edge-eu-09 show repeated `eth0: link down` and `mlx5 NIC reset` messages.
Sofia (API): Traces show requests routed through those nodes hit `upstream reset` and timeouts. No auth or app-level errors. Backends healthy per health endpoint.
incident-bot: AGGREGATE: edge-eu-west 5xx 30% (5m). PagerDuty: Tara paged. Severity: high. Customer-impact tag: partner-critical.
Diego (Support): Receiving a high-priority report from a partner integration; they see intermittent 502s and timeouts. They're asking for a quick status message.
Tara (SRE): Immediate plan: 1) isolate affected nodes from rotation 2) enable fallback routing to internal proxy pool in EU 3) craft customer note 4) start hardware ticket for flaky NICs. Omar, remove nodes and run direct-backend curl tests from healthy edge.
Omar (Edge): Deregistering edge-eu-09 and edge-eu-07 from the TG: `aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn arn:... --targets Id=i-0aa111 Id=i-0bb222`
incident-bot: CONFIG_CHANGE: target-group updated by Omar at 1967000018.
Omar (Edge): After deregister, 5xx dropped to ~4% within 90s. Good signal that these hosts were primary.
Sofia (API): While hardware investigates, I recommend enabling the EU internal proxy pool as fallback for 10m to absorb any residual traffic spikes. We also should temporarily increase gateway upstream timeout to 35s and reduce aggressive retries.
Tara (SRE): Agreed. Omar, flip fallback route and patch gateway timeout. Use conservative language for customer comms. Diego, prepare the message — include times and impacted region.
Omar (Edge): Enabling fallback routing: `redwoodctl routing set --region eu-west --fallback-proxy internal-eu-pool --duration 10m` -> applied. Patching gateway config: `gateway.upstream.timeout=35s`, `gateway.retries.enabled=false` applied to west-eu cluster. Rolling to active proxies.
incident-bot: CONFIG_CHANGE: routing & gateway timeout updated by Omar at 1967000055.
Diego (Support): Draft status: "We're investigating elevated 502/504 responses for API traffic in EU-WEST. Affected edge instances were removed and traffic is being routed to fallback proxies. Services are recovering; we'll follow up with an RCA." Posting to status page now.
Tara (SRE): Observability: pull a sample failing trace ID and a few envoy logs from the removed host to attach to the incident doc. Also capture NIC firmware versions. Omar, can you export `sudo ethtool -i eth0` from edge-eu-09 and paste here?
Omar (Edge): ethtool output: ```driver: mlx5_core
version: 5.0.5
firmware-version: 12.4.1
bus-info: 0000:82:00.0``` Noting firmware is older than fleet baseline 12.6.x. dmesg excerpt: `mlx5_core 0000:82:00.0: NIC health event: reset, link down` repeated.
Sofia (API): Trace sample: `trace-id=eu-xyz-778` shows client -> edge-eu-09 -> upstream reset after 2s of connection attempt. Backend returns 200 when routed via other edges. Confirms host-level network issue.
Tara (SRE): Mitigation seems effective: error rate stable at 0.7% for 10m and p95 latency back to 190ms. Keep edge-eu-07/09 out of rotation and open hardware tickets.
Omar (Edge): Created HW ticket HW-2145 assigned to site-ops. Added NIC firmware mismatch and dmesg logs. Also flagged that the hosting ISP had a maintenance window overlapping the timeframe; opening ops ticket to correlate.
Diego (Support): Added customer note to status: update includes mitigation timestamp and advisory that we're investigating root cause and will follow up with RCA. Some customers asked if we can provide request-level logs; I'm asking product security for permission to share limited logs.
incident-bot: NOTE: partner-critical customer notified at 1967000092.
Tara (SRE): Action items: (1) keep nodes out-of-service until hardware confirms (Omar) (2) keep fallback routing active for 30m and monitor (Sofia/Omar) (3) schedule RCA with infra, edge, and support (Tara) (4) collect conntrack/TCP retransmit metrics for the window (Sofia). I'll remain on-call for 20m then handoff.
Omar (Edge): Implementing extra alert: if a node sees >2 link flaps in 1m, auto-mark unhealthy. Pushing automation: `infra/alerts/auto-isolate-link-flap` PR open.
Sofia (API): Also adding a short-term circuit-breaker on gateway clusters to limit per-node concurrent upstream connections to 120 to prevent connection pool exhaustion if a node partially degrades.
incident-bot: CONFIG_CHANGE: circuit-breaker applied by Sofia at 1967000140.
Diego (Support): Customers acknowledged mitigation. One partner requested SLA credit guidance; I'm coordinating with bizops to draft a reply after RCA.
Tara (SRE): Handoff: I'll stay linked for 20m, then hand to Omar. If errors regress, page the oncall immediately. Schedule RCA: tomorrow 09:30 UTC with Tara, Omar, Sofia, Diego, and site-ops. Attach logs and the firmware report.
Omar (Edge): I'll take post-incident ownership. Logging all commands and diffs to the incident board. Also adding a follow-up action to standardize NIC firmware checks during provisioning.
incident-bot: INCIDENT: mitigated=true, resolved=false, severity=high, link=https://incidents.redwood/internal/1967000000
Tara (SRE): Thanks team. Final note for postmortem: include timeline, host firmware mismatch, ISP maintenance overlap, and our mitigation steps (node removal, fallback routing, timeout/retry changes). Diego: please keep customers updated after RCA. :thumbsup:
